WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, w.dispatch_date, d.fiscal_period
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
)
SELECT fiscal_period, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) keys, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads,
  SUM(gross_amount) gross, SUM(net_amount) net, MIN(dispatch_date) mn, MAX(dispatch_date) mx
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, dispatch_ts_utc, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
),
l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, p.vat_class, w.status, w.dispatch_date, d.fiscal_period
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dispatch_date
  WHERE w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-29' AND DATE '2024-10-27' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-11-05'
)
SELECT store_id, category='ZZ Test' test, status, vat_rate, vat_class, fiscal_period, 
  COUNT(*) n, SUM(gross_amount) gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS web_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
